# 1. Setup & Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(vegan)
library(ggforce)
library(plotrix)
library(sjPlot)
library(patchwork)
```

# 2.Load and Prepare Benthic Data
```{R}
# Load analysis-ready benthic data and filter for Southern GOC sector
benthic_raw <- read_csv("../analysis_data/RLS_benthic_analysis_ready.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

benthic_southern <- benthic_raw %>% 
  filter(sector == "Southern") %>% 
  mutate(
    t_id = paste(site_code, year, transect_1, sep = "_"),
    site_code = as.factor(site_code),
    reef_name = as.factor(reef_name),
    situation = as.factor(situation),
    zone = as.factor(zone),
    geomorph = as.factor(geomorph)
  )
```


# 3. Figure 13: Southern GOC Benthic Metrics Stack (Hard Coral Cover)
```{r}

# 1. Calculate total hard coral cover per transect, then mean per site
hc_data <- benthic_southern %>% 
  filter(new_category_3 == "Hard_coral") %>% 
  group_by(reef_name, situation, zone, t_id) %>% 
  summarise(total_cover = sum(percent_cover), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(reef_name, situation, zone) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_cover = mean(total_cover), 
    se = std.error(total_cover), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(zone_sit = paste(zone, situation, sep = "_"))

# Colors for Southern GOC zones/situations
col_14 <- c("#54C1CB", "#D0D1D1", "#BDDBDD")

# 2. Generate Figure 13
fig_13 <- ggplot(hc_data, aes(y = mean_cover, x = reef_name, fill = zone_sit)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cover - se, ymax = mean_cover + se), width = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_14) +
  ylab("Mean Hard Coral Cover (±SE %)") +
  xlab("") +
  labs(fill = "Zone/Situation") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 60)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  ggforce::facet_row(zone ~ fct_relevel(situation, "Offshore", "Nearshore"), scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 2),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

fig_13

tab_df(hc_data)



```
# 4. Figure 14: Southern GOC Benthic Metrics Stack (Hard Coral Cover by morphology)
```{r}
# 1. Filter for morphological categories and compute means/SE
morph_data <- benthic_southern %>% 
  filter(new_category_5 %in% c("Complex", "Massive/encrusting")) %>% 
  group_by(reef_name, zone, situation, new_category_5, t_id) %>% 
  summarise(total_cover = sum(percent_cover), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(reef_name, zone, situation, new_category_5) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_cover = mean(total_cover), 
    se = std.error(total_cover), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Add dummy zero rows for sites lacking complex coral records
morph_data <- morph_data %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  add_row(reef_name = "Carpentaria Reef SW", situation = "Offshore", zone = "Blue", mean_cover = 0.0, se = 0, new_category_5 = "Complex") %>% 
  add_row(reef_name = "Glasseye Reef", situation = "Offshore", zone = "Blue", mean_cover = 0.0, se = 0, new_category_5 = "Complex")

# 2. Generate Figure 14
fig_14 <- ggplot(morph_data, aes(y = mean_cover, x = reef_name, fill = new_category_5)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black", position = position_dodge(1)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cover - se, ymax = mean_cover + se), width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F4D35E", "#175793")) +
  ylab("Mean Coral Cover (±SE %)") +
  xlab("") +
  labs(fill = "Coral Morphology") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 60)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  ggforce::facet_row(zone ~ fct_relevel(situation, "Offshore", "Nearshore"), scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 2),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

fig_14

tab_df(morph_data)

```
# 5. Figure 19 - 36 sites across broader GOC region
```{R}
# Filter for report sites across the 34 regional locations
benthic_36 <- benthic_raw %>% 
  mutate(
    sector = if_else(sector == "Mornington", "Southern", sector),
    t_id = paste(site_code, year, transect_1, sep = "_"),
    site_code = as.factor(site_code),
    reef_name = as.factor(reef_name),
    sector = fct_relevel(sector, "Outer-shoals", "Wessel", "Northwest", "Western", "Southern", "Northeast"),
    zone_sec = as.factor(paste(zone, sector, sep = "_")) %>% 
      fct_relevel("Open_Outer-shoals", "Open_Wessel", "Open_Northwest", "Open_Western", "Blue_Southern", "Open_Southern", "Open_Northeast")
  )

# 1. Calculate total hard coral cover per transect, then mean per site across the 34 sites
hc_36 <- benthic_36 %>% 
  filter(new_category_3 == "Hard_coral", report_site == "Yes") %>% 
  group_by(reef_name, region, sector, situation, zone, zone_sec, t_id) %>% 
  summarise(total_cover = sum(percent_cover), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(reef_name, region, sector, situation, zone, zone_sec) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_cover = mean(total_cover), 
    se = std.error(total_cover), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Define regional palette for sectors/zones
col_36 <- c("#EE8434", "#990033", "#94A89A", "#795C5F", "#54C1CB", "#D0D1D1", "#FADF7F")
sector_formula <- fct_relevel(sector, "Outer-shoals", "Wessel", "Northwest", "Western", "Southern", "Northeast") ~ zone

# 2. Generate Figure 19
fig_19 <- ggplot(hc_36, aes(y = mean_cover, x = reef_name, fill = zone_sec)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cover - se, ymax = mean_cover + se), width = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_36) +
  ylab("Mean Hard Coral Cover (±SE %)") +
  xlab("") +
  labs(fill = "Zone/Sector") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 80)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  ggforce::facet_row(sector_formula, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 2),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

fig_19


tab_df(hc_36)
```
# 6. Figure 20: Hard Coral Cover by Morphology across 36 Sites
```{R}
# 1. Filter for morphological categories (Complex vs Massive/encrusting) across 34 report sites
morph_36 <- benthic_36 %>% 
  filter(report_site == "Yes", new_category_5 %in% c("Complex", "Massive/encrusting")) %>% 
  group_by(reef_name, region, sector, situation, zone, zone_sec, new_category_5, t_id) %>% 
  summarise(total_cover = sum(percent_cover), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(reef_name, region, sector, situation, zone, zone_sec, new_category_5) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_cover = mean(total_cover), 
    se = std.error(total_cover), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Add dummy rows for missing morph combinations where required
morph_36 <- morph_36 %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  add_row(reef_name = "Carpentaria Reef SW", region = "GOC", sector = "Southern", situation = "Offshore", zone = "Blue", zone_sec = "Blue_Southern", mean_cover = 0.0, se = 0, new_category_5 = "Complex") %>% 
  add_row(reef_name = "Glasseye Reef", region = "GOC", sector = "Southern", situation = "Offshore", zone = "Blue", zone_sec = "Blue_Southern", mean_cover = 0.0, se = 0, new_category_5 = "Complex") %>% 
  add_row(reef_name = "Arafura Shoal", region = "WA", sector = "Outer-shoals", situation = "Offshore", zone = "Open", zone_sec = "Open_Outer-shoals", mean_cover = 0.0, se = 0, new_category_5 = "Complex") %>%
  add_row(reef_name = "Truant Island S", region = "WA", sector = "Wessel", situation = "Nearshore", zone = "Open", zone_sec = "Open_Wessel", mean_cover = 0.0, se = 0, new_category_5 = "Complex")

sector_formula <- fct_relevel(sector, "Outer-shoals", "Wessel", "Northwest", "Western", "Southern", "Northeast") ~ zone

# 2. Generate Figure 20
fig_20 <- ggplot(morph_36, aes(y = mean_cover, x = reef_name, fill = new_category_5)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black", position = position_dodge(1)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cover - se, ymax = mean_cover + se), width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F4D35E", "#175793")) + # Yellow for Complex, Dark Blue for Massive/encrusting
  ylab("Mean Coral Cover (±SE %)") +
  xlab("") +
  labs(fill = "Coral Morphology") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 60)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  ggforce::facet_row(sector_formula, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 2),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

fig_20

tab_df(morph_36)

```
